title: The Xuanwu Sect's Provocation
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Xuanwu Sect's envoy was about to present irrefutable evidence, a deafening rumble suddenly echoed from outside the imperial city—it was a major upheaval that Chen Ji had already foreseen, yet deliberately allowed to happen.

text.content: The echo from the depths of the altar still reverberated in his ears, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his fingertips digging deep into the cold stone crevices. That voice... it was unmistakably the voice of Chen Nian, whom he had been desperately searching for all these years! But in the Tianji Record's foresight, the images of her had always been hazy, like viewing the moon through clouds. For her clear voice to suddenly echo here now—what did this mean? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul coldly spoke in his mind: 'She has touched something she should not have. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key has begun to resonate... but now is not the time. The people from Xuanwu Sect have already entered the imperial city.' Chen Ji raised his head sharply, a flash of murderous intent in his eyes, only to be forcibly suppressed. He had taken note of the matter concerning his sister.

dialogue.content: The Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder? Chen Ji straightened his robes, his tone平静得近乎冷漠平静得近乎冷漠, 'He arrived three days earlier than I anticipated. It seems the Tianqing Sect leaked information.' He took a deep breath, pressing all his anger and worry deep into the bottom of his heart, his face resuming that harmless wastrel appearance. But his tightly clenched fists had whitened knuckles, betraying the turbulence within. The voice from the altar's depths still echoed in his mind—Chen Nian, wait for me.

text.content: Inside the imperial city's Taihe Hall, the atmosphere was suffocating. Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder Xuan Wuji sat calmly in the guest's seat, his hair and beard all white yet his gaze sharp as an eagle, an overwhelming pressure emanating from him that made all the civil and military officials present feel breathless. Behind him stood dozens of black-robed disciples, and leading them was a name Chen Ji had long harbored hatred for—Han Lie. At this moment, Han Lie wore a disdainful smirk, as if he had already foreseen the outcome of this court game. The Crown Prince sat beside the dragon throne, his expression grave, his eyes frequently glancing toward the hall door—he was waiting for Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: Your Highness the Crown Prince, our Xuanwu Sect respects imperial authority, and specially sent the Grand Elder personally. Han Lie stepped forward, his voice resonating through the entire great hall, 'However, I have something unclear—exactly who is this Grand Preceptor Chen Ji newly appointed by Your Majesty? As far as I know, there is a worthless servant disciple at the Tianqing Sect named Chen Ji, who has spent more than ten years at the sect without breaking through the Qi Refining realm. This person suddenly appears in the imperial city and is appointed Grand Preceptor...' He deliberately paused, his gaze sweeping across the startled faces of the ministers, his smirk growing even more pronounced, 'Could it be that someone dares to deceive our sect, daring to substitute the fake for the genuine?'

text.content: At these words, the court erupted in an uproar. The ministers whispered amongst themselves, murmuring voices rising and falling. The Crown Prince's expression darkened, just as he was about to speak, when Xuan Wuji slowly raised his hand, stopping the Crown Prince's speech. The old man's voice was aged yet full of vitality: 'Your Highness the Crown Prince, please remain calm. Our Xuanwu Sect has always acted with reason and evidence.' He withdrew a jade slip from his sleeve and gently tossed it. The jade slip floated in the center of the great hall, its images flowing—clearly showing Chen Ji being humiliated at the Tianqing Sect's Servants' Quarters in past years, as well as his blurry silhouette when he 'faked his death' and escaped. 'This person's identity is questionable. We request the imperial court provide an explanation.'

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect's envoy publicly questioned your identity in court and even displayed so-called 'evidence'. In the court, the ministers' gazes converge, the Crown Prince awaits your stance—how will you deal with this sudden provocation?

choices.description: Publicly expose the Xuanwu Sect's conspiracy, question their motives for fabricating evidence, and slap them with facts to make their opponents unable to back down.
choices.visible_cost: Completely Break with the Xuanwu Sect
choices.visible_reward: Establish authority before the imperial court ministers, prove your strength
choices.risk_hint: May escalate contradictions between the sect and imperial power

text.content: Footsteps echoed at the hall entrance, and Chen Ji slowly walked into the Taihe Hall. He glanced at the floating jade slip image and suddenly let out a light laugh. 'Interesting,' his voice was unhurried, 'Is this the level of the Xuanwu Sect's intelligence? They didn't even capture my face clearly, yet dare to present this as court evidence?'

choices.description: Counterattack by leveraging the Crown Prince's power, implying the Xuanwu Sect's actions are challenging imperial authority, elevating a personal conflict into a confrontation between the sect and the imperial court.
choices.visible_cost: Owe a favor to the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: Use imperial power to suppress the Xuanwu Sect, infuriating Han Lie to death
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as a pawn by the Crown Prince

text.content: Chen Ji calmly bowed to the Crown Prince, his voice calm yet carrying hidden sharp edges: 'Your Highness the Crown Prince, the Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder personally visiting the imperial city is originally a friendly exchange between nations. However, for an envoy to publicly question a Grand Preceptor personally appointed by His Majesty in court—is this questioning the Grand Preceptor's identity, or questioning His Majesty's imperial decree?'

choices.description: First appear weak and acknowledge some facts, wait until the opponent becomes complacent before revealing your true trump card, making the Xuanwu Sect lift a rock only to drop it on their own feet.
choices.visible_reward: Make the Xuanwu Sect humiliate themselves publicly, losing all face
choices.risk_hint: Requires extremely strong psychological composure to refrain from acting

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, revealing a frightened and uneasy expression, his voice slightly trembling: "This... Senior Han is correct, this humble one was indeed a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect. But that Jade Slip's image is so blurry—how can you be certain it's the same person? Could it be that the Xuanwu Sect's ability is to condemn people through speculation?" His voice grew softer and softer, as if scared out of his wits, but the cold light in his eyes flashed and vanished.

dialogue.content: Seeing Chen Ji's timid appearance, Han Lie grew increasingly arrogant. He stepped forward boldly, pointing at Chen Ji's nose with a cold sneer: "A废物 is a废物—back then you couldn't even block my three moves, and now you dare to put on an act before me? If you know what's good for you, get out of the imperial city yourself, stop embarrassing yourself!" His voice was sharp and harsh, giving Chen Ji not even a shred of dignity. The ministers looked at each other in bewilderment; some showed pity, but none dared to speak—the pressure from the Xuanwu Sect was simply too great, no one dared to offend them easily.

text.content: The Crown Prince's face turned livid. Just as he was about to rebuke Han Lie for his impropriety, he saw Chen Ji slowly raise his head. Those eyes were terrifyingly calm, like an ancient fierce beast lurking beneath a deep abyss. "Han Lie," Chen Ji's voice drifted lightly, yet sent a bone-deep chill through everyone present, "do you remember what you said three years ago when we met in the Demon Beast Valley?" Han Lie froze, his brow furrowing. A mocking curve appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: "You said—'废物, get back to farming, stop being an eyesore here.'"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji began his counterattack against Han Lie's provocation, and the court atmosphere instantly tensed. The Crown Prince and ministers were all watching to see how this clash between sect and imperial power would unfold—your method of counterattack will determine the direction of the coming situation:

choices.description: Publicly expose Han Lie's weaknesses, slap him with facts, making this genius lose all face before the ministers.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses face publicly, his reputation damaged
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Han Lie to attack on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his tone full of pity: "Alas, back then you saw me as a废物 who couldn't even break through the Qi Refining realm, yet now the Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder personally had to come after me." He paused, the curve at the corner of his mouth becoming even more pronounced, "Senior Han, are you in such a rush to jump out because you're afraid that the longer I stay in the imperial city, the more embarrassing it will become for you?"

choices.description: No longer concealing cultivation, directly intimidate Han Lie with absolute strength, letting everyone witness the true Chen Ji.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie gets slapped in public, Xuanwu Sect loses face completely
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from larger forces

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing more, only raising his hand and flicking gently. A fierce sword qi shot from his fingertip, instantly slicing off a strand of hair at Han Lie's temple. Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply—he hadn't reacted at all! "Three years ago you said I couldn't block your three moves," Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his tone placid, "now you can't even block my single move." Within the great hall, a deathly silence fell.

choices.text: Luring the Snake Out of Its Lair
choices.description: Deliberately showing weakness to lure Han Lie into attacking first, giving the dynasty legitimate reason to counter the Xuanwu Sect's disrespect.
choices.visible_cost: May get injured by Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the Xuanwu Sect's weakness and counterattack using imperial power

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped backward, fear appearing on his face: "Senior Han, please forgive me, this humble one was wrong..." His voice trembled, perfectly portraying someone scared out of his wits. Han Lie grew even more arrogant, actually raising his hand to slap Chen Ji's face. At that moment, the Crown Prince slammed the dragon throne's armrest: "Unbridled! In the imperial court, how dare you, a Xuanwu Sect disciple, assault someone!"

dialogue.content: Just as the court atmosphere reached a critical tension, Xuan Wuji, who had been silent all along, suddenly spoke. The elder's voice was terrifyingly calm, as if stating an insignificant fact: "Elder Chen, there's something I don't understand and wish to clarify directly." He rose slowly, his gaze sharp as lightning, fixed intently on Chen Ji's eyes, "You claim to be a Tianqing Sect disciple, yet you faked your death to escape the sect, infiltrated the imperial city, and deceived your way to the Grand Preceptor position—all this, who orchestrated it? Was it your own idea, or a scheme by the Tianqing Sect... or even higher powers?" These words cut to the heart, directly elevating Chen Ji's identity issue to the height of a sect conspiracy.

text.content: The Crown Prince's expression shifted subtly. Xuan Wuji's move was too ruthless—if Chen Ji admitted to being manipulated by the Tianqing Sect, the dynasty would have grounds to investigate the Tianqing Sect's interference in court politics; if Chen Ji denied it, that would confirm his personal crime of deceiving the emperor. Either answer was a dead end. The ministers realized this too, their gazes toward Chen Ji now carrying more sympathy and pity. This young man was likely about to fall into the Xuanwu Sect's hands. A satisfied smile appeared on Han Lie's face, as if he could already see Chen Ji's downfall.

dialogue.content: Yet Chen Ji smiled. That smile was calm, composed, even playful. "Grand Elder, you certainly know how to make grand accusations," he stepped forward unhurriedly, his voice measured, "manipulated by the Tianqing Sect? If I were truly someone from the Tianqing Sect, why would I have endured over a decade of humiliation within the sect? Why would I need to fake my death to escape? As for higher powers..." He deliberately paused, his gaze meaningfully sweeping across Xuan Wuji's face, "Grand Elder might as well speak plainly—who exactly do you imply by 'higher powers'?" Xuan Wuji's pupils slightly contracted, but he offered no response. The curve at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth grew more pronounced: "Or perhaps the Xuanwu Sect's grand spectacle this time is itself merely one piece on someone's chessboard?"

text.content: "As soon as these words were spoken, murmurs erupted throughout the court. Xuan Wuji's expression subtly darkened—this discarded disciple was far more formidable than the rumors suggested. He had originally thought that merely presenting evidence and applying pressure would expose Chen Ji completely, never expecting his opponent to not only handle the situation with ease but also turn the tables. The old man's heart filled with hidden vigilance, yet his face remained unmoved: 'Elder Chen's silver tongue is indeed well-deserved reputation. However, this old man's visit today isn't solely to investigate your identity—' He pivoted sharply, his voice turning cold and fierce, 'The Xuanwu Sect has an urgent matter that requires direct confrontation with Elder Chen.' With that, he drew a bloodstained jade pendant from his sleeve, 'Do you recognize this item, Elder Chen?'"

choice.prompt: "Xuan Wuji revealed a bloodstained jade pendant, claiming he needed to confront Chen Ji. This pendant seemed to have some connection with Chen Ji—you need to respond under the watchful eyes of everyone:"

choices.description: "Directly admit the jade pendant is related to you, but explain there are hidden circumstances behind it, using this to expose the Xuanwu Sect as the true mastermind behind the scenes."
choices.visible_reward: "Let the Xuanwu Sect's conspiracy be exposed to the world"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at the jade pendant, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. It was a keepsake left by his mother, taken by force fifteen years ago with no news since. He drew a a deep breath, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'I recognize this jade pendant. But shouldn't the Grand Elder explain to everyone present how it came into the Xuanwu Sect's possession?' He looked around, his gaze sweeping across the faces of the ministers, 'Fifteen years ago, my mother was abducted, and this item has been missing ever since. Now it appears in the Xuanwu Sect...' He didn't finish, but the meaning was already clear."

choices.description: "Pretend not to recognize the jade pendant, instead ask the Xuanwu Sect where they obtained this thing, putting the opponent in an explanation dilemma."
choices.visible_reward: "Let the Xuanwu Sect lose their composure"

text.content: "Chen Ji glanced at the jade pendant, his face showing a dazed expression: 'What does the Grand Elder mean by this? This jade pendant style is quite common, sold in shops all over the streets. I wonder where the Grand Elder found such an item, insisting it's related to me?' His tone was sincere and innocent, as if he truly didn't recognize it. Xuan Wuji furrowed his brow slightly—the boy either truly doesn't know, or his acting is superb. He coldly snorted: 'Elder Chen truly doesn't recognize it? Then let this old man remind you—the back of this jade pendant bears the Chen family crest.'"

choices.description: "Directly question whether the jade pendant is connected to your mother's abduction fifteen years ago, turning the spearhead toward the Xuanwu Sect's crimes."
choices.risk_hint: "May be counterattacked by the Xuanwu Sect"

text.content: "Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned ice-cold and sharp. Word by word, his voice seemed to come from the abyss of the Nine Underworlds: 'Fifteen years ago, my mother was abducted, her life and death unknown to this day. This jade pendant is the Chen family's sole token of trust, disappearing without a trace since then. Now it appears in the hands of the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder—' He stepped forward, his aura suddenly soaring, 'Dare I ask Xuan Wuji, what connection does the Xuanwu Sect have with that bloodbath fifteen years ago?' The court erupted in an uproar. Xuan Wuji's expression slightly changed, a flicker of panic crossing his eyes."

"Just as both sides were at a stalemate, hurried footsteps suddenly echoed outside the hall. A military commander rushed into the hall, kneeling on one knee: 'Reporting to Your Highness and all lords, a large gathering of cultivators has suddenly appeared outside the imperial city. The leader claims...' He swallowed hard, his voice trembling, 'Claims that the Xuanwu Sect Saint Maiden is being held by the imperial court, demanding we release her immediately, or they will assault the imperial city by force!' The Crown Prince abruptly stood up, his expression greatly changed. Xuan Wuji also frowned—this wasn't part of his arrangement, who is stirring up trouble behind the scenes? A subtle smile unconsciously curved Chen Ji's lips: As expected, they've come."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, breaking the tense atmosphere in the hall. 'Grand Elder,' his voice carried a hint of playfulness, 'it seems today's drama is far more spectacular than either of us anticipated. The identity of those people outside the imperial city, you're more familiar with them than I am, aren't you?' Xuan Wuji's expression turned gloomy, staring fixedly at Chen Ji as if trying to read something from his face. This waste... exactly how many hidden cards does he still hold? Han Lie also put away his previous arrogance, his expression grave as he stared toward the hall entrance. The situation had completely slipped beyond his control. The Crown Prince looked around the hall, his voice steady yet urgent: 'Gentlemen, this is not the time to pursue the matter of identity. The safety of the imperial city is paramount.'"

text.content: "The rumbling outside grew increasingly clear, and the imperial city's barrier began to ripple. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze deep and profound. That call from the depths of the altar still echoed in his ears—Chen Nian, wait for me. Yet this carefully arranged probe by the Xuanwu Sect had unexpectedly become a piece in his own chess game. He had foreseen this moment and prepared for it long ago. Only, he hadn't expected the Xuanwu Sect's hidden cards to be even more numerous than he imagined. Xuan Wuji suddenly coldly laughed: 'Elder Chen, do you think delaying until reinforcements arrive will allow you to escape unscathed?' He drew a jade slip from his sleeve, his voice sinister, 'This old man still has one final trump card—ironclad evidence of your faked death!'"

dialogue.content: "The jade slip in Xuan Wuji's hand suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, an image appearing in the air—the complete record of Chen Ji's night of faked death, including how he took the turtle-shell-suppressing pill, how he 'died' before everyone, and how he was taken away by mysterious figures... every detail crystal clear. 'Chen Ji, what else do you have to say?' Xuan Wuji's voice echoed through the great hall, 'Deceiving the emperor, fabricating death news, infiltrating the imperial court—any single one of these is a crime punishable by extermination of nine clans!' The ministers' faces turned ashen as they all retreated. The Crown Prince also showed difficulty, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying additional complexity. Chen Ji... exactly who are you?"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood in place, facing evidence sufficient to condemn him to death, yet his face showed not a trace of panic. He simply watched that recording quietly, as if observing a drama that had nothing to do with him. After a moment, he gently applauded. 'Magnificent,' his voice eerily calm, 'The Xuanwu Sect truly went to great lengths to deal with me, Chen Ji. This recording is flawless, even I must admire the craftsman's dedication.' Xuan Wuji furrowed his brow: 'What do you mean?' The curve of Chen Ji's lips grew more pronounced: 'What I mean is—the so-called 'Chen Ji' in this recording, from beginning to end... is not me.'"

Before the words even finished, Chen Ji waved his hand, and an arcane talisman shot from his fingertips, striking the suspended Jade Slip. In an instant, the image on the Jade Slip violently distorted, then—shattered and dissipated. "Illusion?" Xuan Wuji's pupils constricted sharply, his expression finally changing. "Impossible! I personally inspected this Jade Slip, there are absolutely no illusion traces!" Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his voice cold: "What the Grand Elder inspected was indeed not an illusion. But unfortunately, you have been deceived." He turned to face the Crown Prince, bowing respectfully, "Your Highness, please examine this carefully. This image is a counterfeit designed to deceive. The real Chen Ji never faked his death—because the real Chen Ji never died."

A deathly silence filled the hall. Xuan Wuji's face was livid, and Han Lie was even more incredulous. How could this be possible? They had verified it countless times, the image was flawless! How did Chen Ji manage this? Just then, another explosion came from outside the hall—the Imperial City barrier had finally been breached. The Crown Prince's expression darkened: "Chen Taishi, this is not the time to pursue matters of authenticity. The Imperial City is in imminent danger. Do you have a strategy to repel the enemy?" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze profound: "Your Highness, rest assured, I have long been prepared. However..." He paused, looking at Xuan Wuji, "The Xuanwu Sect will need to give me an explanation first."

dialogue.content: Han Lie could no longer hold back, shouting sternly: "Chen Ji! Stop your tricks here! The Imperial City barrier has been breached—you are the culprit! If not for you attracting these unknown forces, how would the Imperial City have come to this?" Spiritual energy surged around him, showing faint signs of wanting to strike. Chen Ji didn't even glance at him, simply saying calmly: "Senior Han is anxious?" A mocking arc curled at the corner of his lips, "The origins of those people outside the Imperial City—does the Xuanwu Sect not know clearly? The Grand Elder just said the image on the Jade Pendant was 'flawless,' but what is truly flawless is this grand chess game the Xuanwu Sect has set up, isn't it?"

text.content: Just as both sides remained locked in a standoff, the barrier above the Imperial City shattered with a thunderous crash. A figure descended from the sky, landing in the main hall—it was Ye Qing! The Demonic Path Saint was surrounded by eerie black mist. Her gaze swept across the entire hall before finally fixing on Chen Ji. "Chen Ji," her voice was cold as ice, "Is this your 'preparation'?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Lady Ye arrived at just the right moment." He turned to the Crown Prince, bowing respectfully, "Your Highness, the evidence of the Xuanwu Sect's collusion with the Demonic Path and their intent to subvert the dynasty lies before you. This Demonic Path Saint can testify." At these words, everyone in the hall was shocked—the Xuanwu Sect colluding with the Demonic Path? This was utterly slanderous!

Xuan Wuji's expression changed dramatically, and Han Lie was practically hopping with rage: "Absolute nonsense! Our Xuanwu Sect is the leader of the righteous path—how could we collude with the Demonic Path? Chen Ji, you're throwing around baseless accusations!" But Ye Qing coldly smiled, her voice echoing through the hall: "The Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder, Xuan Wuji, thirty years ago signed a secret pact with our Holy Sect, trading the Imperial City defense map in exchange for the Holy Sect's support in his bid for the position of Chief among the Three Great Sects. This secret pact—does the Grand Elder still remember it?" Black mist coalesced in her hand, forming a yellowed contract that hovered in mid-air. Xuan Wuji's face went ashen—this pact, he had clearly destroyed it already, so why was it appearing here?

Chen Ji quietly watched Xuan Wuji's ashen face, his mind racing with calculations. That voice from the depths of the altar—Chen Nian—was still echoing in his ears. She had touched something she shouldn't have, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key began to resonate... These were the words Mo Xiansheng had just spoken. Chen Nian, what had she discovered? And the Xuanwu Sect's probing, the Demonic Path's involvement, the Imperial City's crisis... did all of this point to the same mastermind behind the scenes? The Eye of Heavenly Dao—Chen Ji thought this name, his eyes flashing with a cold, sharp light. Whoever was setting up this chess game, he would not back down.
